title: FAINTING HEART
WAITING SOUL
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: midday sun pouring through dust motes
still glass of water on dark wood desk
golden wheat field blowing in noon wind
open Bible on wooden table bright light
soft shadows moving across white wall
lone tree silhouetted against bright midday sky

scenes.a: That persistent doubt about your future is keeping you from seeing the path ahead today.
I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
Lord, help me stop striving against the heavy things that I cannot fix on my own.
Grant me the stillness to rely on your timing instead of my own anxious heartbeat now.
Anchor my spirit in your unwavering presence as the afternoon sun marks this quiet time.
